summary: Many real-world datasets contain hidden structure that cannot be detected by simple linear correlations between input features. For example, latent factors may influence the data in a coordinated way, even though their effect is invisible to covariance-based methods such as PCA. In practice, nonlinear neural networks often succeed in extracting such hidden structure in unsupervised and self-supervised learning. However, constructing a minimal high-dimensional model where this advantage can be rigorously analyzed has remained an open theoretical challenge. We introduce a tractable high-dimensional spiked model with two latent factors: one visible to covariance, and one statistically dependent yet uncorrelated, appearing only in higher-order moments. PCA and linear autoencoders fail to recover the latter, while a minimal nonlinear autoencoder provably extracts both. We analyze both the population risk, and empirical risk minimization. Our model also provides a tractable example where self-supervised test loss is poorly aligned with representation quality: nonlinear autoencoders recover latent structure that linear methods miss, even though their reconstruction loss is higher.

title: Convergence Rates for Distribution Matching with Sliced Optimal Transport
summary: We study the slice-matching scheme, an efficient iterative method for distribution matching based on sliced optimal transport. We investigate convergence to the target distribution and derive quantitative non-asymptotic rates. To this end, we establish __ojasiewicz-type inequalities for the Sliced-Wasserstein objective. A key challenge is to control along the trajectory the constants in these inequalities. We show that this becomes tractable for Gaussian distributions. Specifically, eigenvalues are controlled when matching along random orthonormal bases at each iteration. We complement our theory with numerical experiments and illustrate the predicted dependence on dimension and step-size, as well as the stabilizing effect of orthonormal-basis sampling.

AI.title_translation: 分布匹配中切片最优传输的收敛速度
AI.tldr: 本文研究了基于切片最优传输的切片匹配方案的收敛速度，推导了量化非渐近收敛速度，并建立了Ojasiewicz型不等式。论文证明了该方法在高斯分布下的可行性，并通过数值实验验证了理论。
AI.motivation: 研究基于切片最优传输的切片匹配方案的收敛性，并推导其量化非渐近收敛速度。
AI.method: 研究切片匹配方案，建立切片Wasserstein目标函数的Ojasiewicz型不等式，并解决控制不等式中常数的挑战。对于高斯分布，通过在每次迭代中沿随机正交基进行匹配来控制特征值。通过数值实验验证理论。
AI.result: 推导了量化非渐近收敛速度。证明了对于高斯分布，通过沿随机正交基匹配可以控制特征值，从而使常数控制变得可行。数值实验证实了对维度和步长的预测依赖性，以及正交基采样的稳定效果。
AI.conclusion: 论文成功地为基于切片最优传输的分布匹配方案推导了收敛速度，并通过理论和实验证明了其在高斯分布下的有效性和稳定性。
AI.translation: 我们研究了切片匹配方案，这是一种基于切片最优传输的高效迭代分布匹配方法。我们调查了其向目标分布的收敛性，并推导了量化的非渐近收敛速度。为此，我们为切片Wasserstein目标函数建立了Ojasiewicz型不等式。一个关键挑战是在轨迹中控制这些不等式中的常数。我们证明了这对于高斯分布是可行的。具体来说，当在每次迭代中沿随机正交基进行匹配时，特征值得到了控制。我们通过数值实验补充了我们的理论，并说明了对维度和步长的预测依赖性，以及正交基采样的稳定效果。
AI.summary: 本文研究了基于切片最优传输的切片匹配方案的收敛速度。通过建立切片Wasserstein目标函数的Ojasiewicz型不等式，并解决了常数控制的挑战，特别证明了其在高斯分布下的可行性，即通过随机正交基匹配来控制特征值。理论结果得到了数值实验的支持，展示了其对维度和步长的依赖性以及正交基采样的稳定作用。
AI.keywords: 切片最优传输, 分布匹配, 收敛速度, Ojasiewicz型不等式, 高斯分布
AI.comments: 这篇论文在理解基于切片最优传输的分布匹配方法的收敛特性方面取得了重要进展，特别是通过引入Ojasiewicz型不等式并解决高斯分布下的常数控制问题，为该领域提供了坚实的理论基础和实用见解。随机正交基采样策略的引入也提升了方法的稳定性。

title: Robust Assortment Optimization from Observational Data
summary: Assortment optimization is a fundamental challenge in modern retail and recommendation systems, where the goal is to select a subset of products that maximizes expected revenue under complex customer choice behaviors. While recent advances in data-driven methods have leveraged historical data to learn and optimize assortments, these approaches typically rely on strong assumptions -- namely, the stability of customer preferences and the correctness of the underlying choice models. However, such assumptions frequently break in real-world scenarios due to preference shifts and model misspecification, leading to poor generalization and revenue loss. Motivated by this limitation, we propose a robust framework for data-driven assortment optimization that accounts for potential distributional shifts in customer choice behavior. Our approach models potential preference shift from a nominal choice model that generates data and seeks to maximize worst-case expected revenue. We first establish the computational tractability of robust assortment planning when the nominal model is known, then advance to the data-driven setting, where we design statistically optimal algorithms that minimize the data requirements while maintaining robustness. Our theoretical analysis provides both upper bounds and matching lower bounds on the sample complexity, offering theoretical guarantees for robust generalization. Notably, we uncover and identify the notion of ``robust item-wise coverage'' as the minimal data requirement to enable sample-efficient robust assortment learning. Our work bridges the gap between robustness and statistical efficiency in assortment learning, contributing new insights and tools for reliable assortment optimization under uncertainty.

AI.title_translation: 鲁棒的组合优化：基于观测数据
AI.tldr: 针对客户偏好不稳定和模型误设导致的传统组合优化问题，本文提出了一种鲁棒的数据驱动框架，通过建模潜在的偏好转移来最大化最差情况下的预期收益，并设计了统计最优算法，提供了理论保障，同时识别了实现高效鲁棒组合学习的最小数据需求。
AI.motivation: 传统的数据驱动组合优化方法依赖于客户偏好稳定性和选择模型正确性等强假设，但在现实世界中这些假设常被打破，导致泛化能力差和收入损失。
AI.method: 提出一个鲁棒的数据驱动组合优化框架，该框架考虑客户选择行为中潜在的分布偏移。它通过从名义选择模型中建模潜在的偏好转移，并寻求最大化最差情况下的预期收益。该方法首先在名义模型已知时建立鲁棒组合规划的计算可处理性，然后针对数据驱动设置设计统计最优算法，以最小化数据需求同时保持鲁棒性。
AI.result: 建立了鲁棒组合规划的计算可处理性；设计了统计最优算法，可在保持鲁棒性的同时最小化数据需求；理论分析提供了样本复杂度的上下界，并为鲁棒泛化提供了理论保证；识别了“鲁棒逐项覆盖”作为实现样本高效鲁棒组合学习的最小数据要求。
AI.conclusion: 本工作弥合了组合学习中鲁棒性与统计效率之间的鸿沟，为不确定性下的可靠组合优化贡献了新的见解和工具。
AI.translation: 组合优化是现代零售和推荐系统中的一个基本挑战，其目标是选择一个产品子集，以在复杂的客户选择行为下最大化预期收益。虽然数据驱动方法的最新进展利用历史数据来学习和优化组合，但这些方法通常依赖于强假设——即客户偏好的稳定性和底层选择模型的正确性。然而，由于偏好转移和模型误设，这些假设在现实场景中经常失效，导致泛化能力差和收益损失。受此限制的启发，我们提出一个鲁棒的数据驱动组合优化框架，该框架考虑客户选择行为中潜在的分布偏移。我们的方法从一个生成数据的名义选择模型中建模潜在的偏好转移，并寻求最大化最差情况下的预期收益。我们首先在名义模型已知时建立鲁棒组合规划的计算可处理性，然后推进到数据驱动设置，在此设计统计最优算法，以最小化数据需求同时保持鲁棒性。我们的理论分析提供了样本复杂度的上界和匹配的下界，为鲁棒泛化提供了理论保证。值得注意的是，我们揭示并识别了“鲁棒逐项覆盖”的概念，作为实现样本高效鲁棒组合学习的最小数据要求。我们的工作弥合了组合学习中鲁棒性与统计效率之间的鸿沟，为不确定性下的可靠组合优化贡献了新的见解和工具。
AI.summary: 本文针对传统数据驱动组合优化在客户偏好不稳定和模型误设下泛化能力差的问题，提出了一种鲁棒框架。该框架通过建模潜在的偏好转移来最大化最差情况下的预期收益，并设计了统计最优算法以最小化数据需求。研究建立了鲁棒组合规划的计算可处理性，提供了样本复杂度的理论保障，并识别了“鲁棒逐项覆盖”作为实现高效鲁棒学习的最小数据要求，从而在不确定性下提供了可靠的组合优化工具。
AI.keywords: 鲁棒组合优化, 客户选择行为, 分布偏移, 样本复杂度, 数据驱动
AI.comments: 这篇论文的创新点在于它解决了数据驱动组合优化中长期存在的鲁棒性问题，尤其是在客户偏好不确定和模型可能不准确的现实场景中。通过引入最坏情况下的预期收益最大化和“鲁棒逐项覆盖”的概念，该研究不仅提供了理论上的计算可处理性和统计效率保证，而且为实际应用提供了更可靠的工具，对于零售和推荐系统具有重要的实践意义。

title: RE-LLM: Refining Empathetic Speech-LLM Responses by Integrating Emotion Nuance
comments: 5 pages, 1 figure, 2 tables. Accepted at IEEE ASRU 2025
summary: With generative AI advancing, empathy in human-AI interaction is essential. While prior work focuses on emotional reflection, emotional exploration, key to deeper engagement, remains overlooked. Existing LLMs rely on text which captures limited emotion nuances. To address this, we propose RE-LLM, a speech-LLM integrating dimensional emotion embeddings and auxiliary learning. Experiments show statistically significant gains in empathy metrics across three datasets. RE-LLM relatively improves the Emotional Reaction score by 14.79% and 6.76% compared to text-only and speech-LLM baselines on ESD. Notably, it raises the Exploration score by 35.42% and 3.91% on IEMOCAP, 139.28% and 9.83% on ESD, and 60.95% and 22.64% on MSP-PODCAST. It also boosts unweighted accuracy by 5.4% on IEMOCAP, 2.3% on ESD, and 6.9% on MSP-PODCAST in speech emotion recognition. These results highlight the enriched emotional understanding and improved empathetic response generation of RE-LLM.
comment: 5 pages, 1 figure, 2 tables. Accepted at IEEE ASRU 2025

AI.title_translation: RE-LLM：通过整合情感细微性改进共情语音-LLM响应
AI.tldr: RE-LLM是一个语音-LLM，通过整合维度情感嵌入和辅助学习，显著提高了LLM在人类-AI交互中的共情能力，特别是在情感探索方面。
AI.motivation: 现有生成式AI在人机交互中的共情能力不足，特别是情感探索方面被忽视。现有LLM依赖文本，难以捕捉情感细微性。
AI.method: 本文提出了RE-LLM，一个集成了维度情感嵌入和辅助学习的语音-LLM。
AI.result: 实验表明，RE-LLM在三个数据集上显著提升了共情指标。与纯文本和语音-LLM基线相比，在ESD上的情感反应得分分别相对提高了14.79%和6.76%。探索得分在IEMOCAP、ESD和MSP-PODCAST上均有显著提升（例如，ESD上提高了139.28%和9.83%）。此外，在语音情感识别方面，非加权准确率在IEMOCAP、ESD和MSP-PODCAST上分别提高了5.4%、2.3%和6.9%。
AI.conclusion: RE-LLM丰富了情感理解，并改进了共情响应的生成。
AI.translation: 随着生成式AI的进步，人机交互中的共情能力至关重要。虽然之前的工作侧重于情感反映，但对更深层次参与至关重要的情感探索却被忽视了。现有的LLM依赖文本，其捕获的情感细微性有限。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了RE-LLM，一个集成维度情感嵌入和辅助学习的语音-LLM。实验表明，在三个数据集上，共情指标均有统计学上的显著提升。与纯文本和语音-LLM基线相比，RE-LLM在ESD上的情感反应得分分别相对提高了14.79%和6.76%。值得注意的是，它在IEMOCAP上的探索得分提高了35.42%和3.91%，在ESD上提高了139.28%和9.83%，在MSP-PODCAST上提高了60.95%和22.64%。它还在语音情感识别方面，使IEMOCAP、ESD和MSP-PODCAST上的非加权准确率分别提高了5.4%、2.3%和6.9%。这些结果突出了RE-LLM丰富的情感理解和改进的共情响应生成能力。
AI.summary: 本文提出了RE-LLM，一个创新的语音-LLM，旨在通过整合维度情感嵌入和辅助学习来增强生成式AI在人机交互中的共情能力，特别关注此前被忽视的情感探索。实验结果表明，RE-LLM在多个数据集上显著提高了情感反应和情感探索得分，并在语音情感识别方面提升了准确率，证明其能有效丰富情感理解并生成更具共情性的响应。
AI.keywords: 共情AI, 语音-LLM, 情感探索, 维度情感嵌入, 辅助学习
AI.comments: 这篇论文通过引入语音信息和维度情感嵌入，有效解决了传统基于文本的LLM在捕捉情感细微性方面的不足，并特别强调了对“情感探索”这一关键但被忽视的共情维度的提升。其方法创新性地结合了多模态输入和辅助学习，为未来更自然、更具共情能力的人机对话系统提供了有价值的方向。

title: Bayesian Signal Component Decomposition via Diffusion-within-Gibbs Sampling
summary: In signal processing, the data collected from sensing devices is often a noisy linear superposition of multiple components, and the estimation of components of interest constitutes a crucial pre-processing step. In this work, we develop a Bayesian framework for signal component decomposition, which combines Gibbs sampling with plug-and-play (PnP) diffusion priors to draw component samples from the posterior distribution. Unlike many existing methods, our framework supports incorporating model-driven and data-driven prior knowledge into the diffusion prior in a unified manner. Moreover, the proposed posterior sampler allows component priors to be learned separately and flexibly combined without retraining. Under suitable assumptions, the proposed DiG sampler provably produces samples from the posterior distribution. We also show that DiG can be interpreted as an extension of a class of recently proposed diffusion-based samplers, and that, for suitable classes of sensing operators, DiG better exploits the structure of the measurement model. Numerical experiments demonstrate the superior performance of our method over existing approaches.

AI.title_translation: 贝叶斯信号分量分解通过扩散-吉布斯采样
AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种名为DiG的贝叶斯框架，结合吉布斯采样和即插即用（PnP）扩散先验，用于信号分量分解，能够统一整合模型驱动和数据驱动的先验知识，且可证明能从后验分布中采样，并在数值实验中表现出优越性能。
AI.motivation: 在信号处理中，从传感设备收集的数据通常是多个分量的噪声线性叠加，对感兴趣分量的估计是一个关键的预处理步骤。
AI.method: 开发了一个贝叶斯框架用于信号分量分解，该框架将吉布斯采样与即插即用（PnP）扩散先验相结合，以从后验分布中提取分量样本。该方法支持统一整合模型驱动和数据驱动的先验知识，并允许分量先验独立学习和灵活组合而无需重新训练。
AI.result: 在适当假设下，所提出的DiG采样器可证明能从后验分布中产生样本。DiG可被解释为一类最近提出的基于扩散的采样器的扩展，并且对于适当的传感算子，DiG能更好地利用测量模型的结构。数值实验表明该方法优于现有方法。
AI.conclusion: 该工作提出了一种新型的贝叶斯信号分量分解框架（DiG），通过结合吉布斯采样和PnP扩散先验，实现了对信号分量的有效估计，具有统一整合多种先验知识、可证明的理论基础和实验验证的优越性能。
AI.translation: 在信号处理中，从传感设备收集的数据通常是多个分量的噪声线性叠加，对感兴趣分量的估计是一个关键的预处理步骤。在这项工作中，我们开发了一个贝叶斯信号分量分解框架，它将吉布斯采样与即插即用（PnP）扩散先验相结合，以从后验分布中提取分量样本。与许多现有方法不同，我们的框架支持以统一的方式将模型驱动和数据驱动的先验知识整合到扩散先验中。此外，所提出的后验采样器允许分量先验独立学习并灵活组合，无需重新训练。在适当的假设下，所提出的DiG采样器可证明能从后验分布中产生样本。我们还表明，DiG可以被解释为一类最近提出的基于扩散的采样器的扩展，并且对于适当的传感算子，DiG能更好地利用测量模型的结构。数值实验证明了我们方法优于现有方法的卓越性能。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种名为DiG（Diffusion-within-Gibbs）的贝叶斯信号分量分解框架。该方法将吉布斯采样与即插即用（PnP）扩散先验相结合，用于从信号的后验分布中提取分量样本。DiG的创新之处在于能够统一整合模型驱动和数据驱动的先验知识，并支持分量先验的独立学习和灵活组合。理论上，DiG采样器被证明能够从后验分布中生成样本，并且被视为现有扩散采样器的扩展，能更有效地利用测量模型结构。实验结果证实了DiG在性能上优于现有方法。
AI.keywords: 贝叶斯信号分解, 吉布斯采样, 扩散先验, 即插即用, 信号处理
AI.comments: 这项工作的创新之处在于将吉布斯采样与PnP扩散先验相结合，形成了一个统一的贝叶斯框架来解决信号分量分解问题。其重要性体现在能够灵活整合不同来源的先验知识，以及提供可证明的后验采样能力。此外，其作为现有扩散采样器扩展的解释，并能更好地利用测量模型结构，也增加了其理论和实践价值。

title: Splitting Sandwiches Unevenly via Unique Sink Orientations and Rainbow Arrangements
summary: The famous Ham-Sandwich theorem states that any $d$ point sets in $\mathbb{R}^d$ can be simultaneously bisected by a single hyperplane. The $α$-Ham-Sandwich theorem gives a sufficient condition for the existence of biased cuts, i.e., hyperplanes that do not cut off half but some prescribed fraction of each point set. We give two new proofs for this theorem. The first proof is completely combinatorial and highlights a strong connection between the $α$-Ham-Sandwich theorem and Unique Sink Orientations of grids. The second proof uses point-hyperplane duality and the Poincaré-Miranda theorem and allows us to generalize the result to and beyond oriented matroids. For this we introduce a new concept of rainbow arrangements, generalizing colored pseudo-hyperplane arrangements. Along the way, we also show that the realizability problem for rainbow arrangements is $\exists \mathbb{R}$-complete, which also implies that the realizability problem for grid Unique Sink Orientations is $\exists \mathbb{R}$-complete.

AI.title_translation: 通过唯一汇点方向和彩虹排列不均匀分割三明治
AI.tldr: 本文为α-哈姆三明治定理提供了两种新证明，其中一种是组合式的，与网格的唯一汇点方向相关；另一种利用点-超平面对偶和庞加莱-米兰达定理，并将结果推广到有向拟阵，引入了彩虹排列概念，并证明了相关可实现性问题是$\exists \mathbb{R}$-完全的。
AI.motivation: 《哈姆三明治定理》指出任何$d$个$\mathbb{R}^d$中的点集可以被一个超平面同时平分。而$\alpha$-哈姆三明治定理给出了存在偏置切割（即不切掉一半而是一些预定分数）的充分条件。本文的动机是为这一定理提供两种新的证明方法，并将其推广到有向拟阵及更广的范围。
AI.method:
本文采用了两种主要方法：
1.  第一种证明是完全组合式的，强调了$\alpha$-哈姆三明治定理与网格的唯一汇点方向之间的紧密联系。
2.  第二种证明利用了点-超平面对偶和庞加莱-米兰达定理，并引入了彩虹排列这一新概念（推广了彩色伪超平面排列），从而将结果推广到有向拟阵及更广的范围。
AI.result:
1.  为$\alpha$-哈姆三明治定理提供了两个新证明。
2.  第一个证明揭示了$\alpha$-哈姆三明治定理与网格的唯一汇点方向之间的强联系。
3.  第二个证明将结果推广到有向拟阵及更广的范围。
4.  引入了彩虹排列这一新概念，它概括了彩色伪超平面排列。
5.  证明了彩虹排列的可实现性问题是$\exists \mathbb{R}$-完全的。
6.  这还暗示了网格唯一汇点方向的可实现性问题也是$\exists \mathbb{R}$-完全的。
AI.conclusion: 本文为$\alpha$-哈姆三明治定理提供了两种创新的证明方法，不仅揭示了其与唯一汇点方向的深层组合联系，还通过引入彩虹排列和利用拓扑工具，成功将该定理推广到有向拟阵等更广泛的结构。此外，还确立了相关可实现性问题的计算复杂度，证明它们是$\exists \mathbb{R}$-完全的。
AI.translation: 著名的哈姆三明治定理指出，$\mathbb{R}^d$中的任何$d$个点集都可以被一个单一的超平面同时平分。$\alpha$-哈姆三明治定理给出了存在偏置切割（即超平面不切掉一半而是每个点集的某个预定分数）的充分条件。我们为该定理提供了两种新证明。第一个证明是完全组合式的，并强调了$\alpha$-哈姆三明治定理与网格的唯一汇点方向之间的强联系。第二个证明利用了点-超平面对偶和庞加莱-米兰达定理，并允许我们将结果推广到有向拟阵及更广的范围。为此，我们引入了彩虹排列这一新概念，它概括了彩色伪超平面排列。在此过程中，我们还表明彩虹排列的可实现性问题是$\exists \mathbb{R}$-完全的，这也意味着网格唯一汇点方向的可实现性问题是$\exists \mathbb{R}$-完全的。
AI.summary: 本文为$\alpha$-哈姆三明治定理提供了两种新的证明方法。第一种是纯组合式的，揭示了该定理与网格唯一汇点方向的联系。第二种利用点-超平面对偶和庞加莱-米兰达定理，将定理推广到有向拟阵，并引入了彩虹排列的概念。研究还表明，彩虹排列和网格唯一汇点方向的可实现性问题都是$\exists \mathbb{R}$-完全的。
AI.keywords: 哈姆三明治定理, 唯一汇点方向, 彩虹排列, 有向拟阵, 计算复杂性
AI.comments: 本文的创新之处在于为$\alpha$-哈姆三明治定理提供了两种截然不同的新证明，并显著扩展了其理论范畴。通过第一个组合证明，它揭示了经典几何定理与图论中唯一汇点方向的深层联系，这本身就是一个重要的跨领域发现。第二个证明则通过引入“彩虹排列”这一新颖概念，并利用拓扑工具，成功地将定理推广到更抽象和广义的有向拟阵结构，极大地拓宽了其适用性。此外，文章还深入探讨了相关可实现性问题的计算复杂性，将其定性为$\exists \mathbb{R}$-完全，这为计算几何和组合学领域提供了重要的复杂性理论见解。

title: Self-Supervised Learning for Speaker Recognition: A study and review
comments: accepted for publication in Speech Communication
summary: Deep learning models trained in a supervised setting have revolutionized audio and speech processing. However, their performance inherently depends on the quantity of human-annotated data, making them costly to scale and prone to poor generalization under unseen conditions. To address these challenges, Self-Supervised Learning (SSL) has emerged as a promising paradigm, leveraging vast amounts of unlabeled data to learn relevant representations. The application of SSL for Automatic Speech Recognition (ASR) has been extensively studied, but research on other downstream tasks, notably Speaker Recognition (SR), remains in its early stages. This work describes major SSL instance-invariance frameworks (e.g., SimCLR, MoCo, and DINO), initially developed for computer vision, along with their adaptation to SR. Various SSL methods for SR, proposed in the literature and built upon these frameworks, are also presented. An extensive review of these approaches is then conducted: (1) the effect of the main hyperparameters of SSL frameworks is investigated; (2) the role of SSL components is studied (e.g., data-augmentation, projector, positive sampling); and (3) SSL frameworks are evaluated on SR with in-domain and out-of-domain data, using a consistent experimental setup, and a comprehensive comparison of SSL methods from the literature is provided. Specifically, DINO achieves the best downstream performance and effectively models intra-speaker variability, although it is highly sensitive to hyperparameters and training conditions, while SimCLR and MoCo provide robust alternatives that effectively capture inter-speaker variability and are less prone to collapse. This work aims to highlight recent trends and advancements, identifying current challenges in the field.
comment: accepted for publication in Speech Communication

AI.title_translation: 说话人识别中的自监督学习：一项研究与综述
AI.tldr: 该论文综述了将SimCLR、MoCo、DINO等自监督学习（SSL）方法应用于说话人识别（SR）的现状，通过实验对比发现DINO效果最好但最难调参，而SimCLR和MoCo更稳定，强调了SSL在无标签语音数据处理中的潜力与挑战。
AI.motivation: 深度学习模型在监督设置下取得了巨大成功，但性能严重依赖于人工标注数据的数量，这使得它们难以扩展且在未见条件下泛化能力差。自监督学习（SSL）利用海量无标签数据学习相关表示，是解决这些挑战的一个有前景的范式。然而，SSL在自动语音识别（ASR）方面研究已很充分，但在说话人识别（SR）等其他下游任务上的研究仍处于早期阶段。
AI.method: 系统地描述了主要的SSL实例不变性框架（如SimCLR, MoCo, DINO）及其在说话人识别（SR）中的适应性。进行了广泛的综述，包括：(1) 研究SSL框架主要超参数的影响；(2) 研究SSL组件（如数据增强、投影器、正样本采样）的作用；(3) 在一致的实验设置下，使用域内和域外数据对SSL框架进行SR评估，并对现有方法进行了全面比较。
AI.result: DINO实现了最佳的下游性能，并能有效建模说话人内部的变异性，但它对超参数和训练条件高度敏感。SimCLR和MoCo提供了更稳健的替代方案，能有效捕获说话人间的变异性，且不易崩溃。
AI.conclusion: 本研究旨在突出该领域的最新趋势和进展，并确定当前的挑战。具体而言，DINO在下游性能上表现最佳，能有效建模说话人内部的变异性，但对超参数和训练条件高度敏感；而SimCLR和MoCo则提供了更稳健的替代方案，能有效捕获说话人间的变异性，且不易崩溃。
AI.translation: 深度学习模型在监督设置下彻底改变了音频和语音处理。然而，它们的性能固有地取决于人工标注数据的数量，这使得它们的扩展成本高昂，并且在未见条件下容易泛化能力差。为应对这些挑战，自监督学习（SSL）已成为一种有前景的范式，它利用海量的无标签数据来学习相关的表示。SSL在自动语音识别（ASR）中的应用已得到广泛研究，但对其他下游任务，特别是说话人识别（SR）的研究仍处于早期阶段。这项工作描述了主要为计算机视觉开发的SSL实例不变性框架（例如SimCLR、MoCo和DINO），以及它们向SR的适应。文中还介绍了文献中提出的、基于这些框架的各种SR的SSL方法。随后对这些方法进行了广泛的回顾：（1）研究了SSL框架主要超参数的影响；（2）研究了SSL组件（例如，数据增强、投影器、正样本采样）的作用；（3）使用一致的实验设置，在域内和域外数据上对SR评估SSL框架，并对文献中的SSL方法进行了全面比较。具体而言，DINO实现了最佳的下游性能，并能有效建模说话人内部的变异性，尽管它对超参数和训练条件高度敏感，而SimCLR和MoCo提供了更稳健的替代方案，能有效捕获说话人间的变异性，且不易崩溃。本工作旨在突出该领域的最新趋势和进展，确定当前的挑战。
AI.summary: 本研究回顾了将计算机视觉中主流的自监督学习（SSL）框架（如SimCLR、MoCo、DINO）应用于说话人识别（SR）的最新进展。通过对超参数、关键组件进行系统性调查，并在一致的实验设置下对现有SSL方法进行了全面比较，研究发现DINO性能最佳但敏感，而SimCLR和MoCo则更为稳健。该工作旨在总结当前趋势、挑战和未来方向。
AI.keywords: 自监督学习, 说话人识别, 对比学习, DINO, 语音处理
AI.comments: 该论文的创新之处在于系统地将计算机视觉中成熟的自监督学习（SSL）框架（如SimCLR, MoCo, DINO）迁移并应用于语音识别（SR）任务，并进行了全面的实证研究和消融实验，指出了SSL在SR领域的前沿趋势和挑战。其重要性在于推动了无标签数据在说话人识别中的应用。局限性在于对超参数的敏感性分析仅限于特定框架。

title: Deep Learning of Compositional Targets with Hierarchical Spectral Methods
summary: Why depth yields a genuine computational advantage over shallow methods remains a central open question in learning theory. We study this question in a controlled high-dimensional Gaussian setting, focusing on compositional target functions. We analyze their learnability using an explicit three-layer fitting model trained via layer-wise spectral estimators. Although the target is globally a high-degree polynomial, its compositional structure allows learning to proceed in stages: an intermediate representation reveals structure that is inaccessible at the input level. This reduces learning to simpler spectral estimation problems, well studied in the context of multi-index models, whereas any shallow estimator must resolve all components simultaneously. Our analysis relies on Gaussian universality, leading to sharp separations in sample complexity between two and three-layer learning strategies.

AI.title_translation: 组合目标函数的深度学习与分层谱方法
AI.tldr: 三层深度网络通过逐层谱估计，能比浅层网络更有效地学习组合目标函数，这在高维高斯模型中导致了更低的样本复杂度。
AI.motivation: 研究深度相对于浅层方法的真正计算优势这一学习理论中的核心未解决问题，特别是在处理组合目标函数时。
AI.method: 使用显式的三层拟合模型，通过逐层谱估计器进行训练，并进行理论分析。
AI.result: 分析显示，目标函数的组合结构允许学习分阶段进行，将学习简化为更简单的谱估计问题，并在两层和三层学习策略之间产生了样本复杂度的清晰分离。
AI.translation: 为什么深度相对于浅层方法会产生真正的计算优势，仍然是学习理论中的一个核心未解决问题。我们在一个受控的高维高斯设置中研究了这个问题，重点关注组合目标函数。我们使用通过逐层谱估计器训练的显式三层拟合模型来分析其可学习性。虽然目标函数在全局上是一个高次多项式，但其组合结构允许学习分阶段进行：中间表示揭示了在输入级别无法获得的结构。这使得学习简化为更简单的谱估计问题，这在多指标模型的背景下得到了充分研究，而任何浅层估计器都必须同时解决所有分量。我们的分析依赖于高斯普适性，从而在两层和三层学习策略之间的样本复杂度上产生了清晰的分离。
AI.summary: 本文在高维高斯设置中研究了组合目标函数的深度学习优势。通过一个三层拟合模型和逐层谱估计，作者证明了深度结构允许学习分阶段进行，将复杂问题分解为更简单的谱估计，从而在样本复杂度上实现了与浅层方法的显著分离。
AI.keywords: 深度学习, 组合目标函数, 谱方法, 样本复杂度, 高斯设置
AI.comments: 该论文通过在受控的高维高斯设置中研究三层拟合模型，为深度学习相对于浅层学习的计算优势提供了一个理论见解。其创新点在于利用分层谱估计器来利用目标函数的组合结构，从而在样本复杂度上实现了与浅层方法的显著分离。限制在于分析仅限于高维高斯设置。

title: Optimal Initialization in Depth: Lyapunov Initialization and Limit Theorems for Deep Leaky ReLU Networks
summary: The development of effective initialization methods requires an understanding of random neural networks. In this work, a rigorous probabilistic analysis of deep unbiased Leaky ReLU networks is provided. We prove a Law of Large Numbers and a Central Limit Theorem for the logarithm of the norm of network activations, establishing that, as the number of layers increases, their growth is governed by a parameter called the Lyapunov exponent. This parameter characterizes a sharp phase transition between vanishing and exploding activations, and we calculate the Lyapunov exponent explicitly for Gaussian or orthogonal weight matrices. Our results reveal that standard methods, such as He initialization or orthogonal initialization, do not guarantee activation stabilty for deep networks of low width. Based on these theoretical insights, we propose a novel initialization method, referred to as Lyapunov initialization, which sets the Lyapunov exponent to zero and thereby ensures that the neural network is as stable as possible, leading empirically to improved learning.

AI.title_translation: 深度最优初始化：深度Leaky ReLU网络的Lyapunov初始化和极限定理
AI.tldr: 本文对深度Leaky ReLU网络进行了严格的概率分析，引入Lyapunov指数来表征激活值的稳定性，发现现有初始化方法不足，并提出了Lyapunov初始化，通过将Lyapunov指数设为零来确保网络稳定性并提升学习效果。
AI.motivation: 开发有效的初始化方法需要理解随机神经网络。
AI.method: 对深度无偏Leaky ReLU网络进行严格的概率分析，证明了网络激活值范数对数的大数定律和中心极限定理，引入Lyapunov指数来描述激活值的增长，并显式计算了高斯或正交权重矩阵的Lyapunov指数。基于理论洞察，提出Lyapunov初始化方法。
AI.result: 激活值的增长由Lyapunov指数控制，该指数表征了激活值消失和爆炸之间的尖锐相变。标准初始化方法（如He或正交初始化）不能保证低宽度深度网络的激活稳定性。Lyapunov初始化通过将Lyapunov指数设为零，确保神经网络尽可能稳定，并经验性地提升了学习效果。
AI.conclusion: Lyapunov初始化是一种有效的新型初始化方法，通过理论推导和实验验证，解决了深度网络激活稳定性问题，并优于现有方法。
AI.translation: 开发有效的初始化方法需要对随机神经网络有深入的理解。在这项工作中，我们对深度无偏Leaky ReLU网络进行了严格的概率分析。我们证明了网络激活值范数对数的大数定律和中心极限定理，确立了随着层数增加，它们的增长由一个称为Lyapunov指数的参数控制。该参数表征了激活值消失和爆炸之间的尖锐相变，我们显式计算了高斯或正交权重矩阵的Lyapunov指数。我们的结果表明，标准方法，如He初始化或正交初始化，不能保证低宽度深度网络的激活稳定性。基于这些理论见解，我们提出了一种新颖的初始化方法，称为Lyapunov初始化，它将Lyapunov指数设置为零，从而确保神经网络尽可能稳定，并在经验上带来了改进的学习效果。
AI.summary: 本文通过对深度无偏Leaky ReLU网络进行严格的概率分析，证明了网络激活值增长受Lyapunov指数控制，该指数是激活值消失与爆炸之间的关键。研究发现现有初始化方法在低宽度深度网络中稳定性不足，并基于此提出了一种名为Lyapunov初始化的新方法，通过将Lyapunov指数设为零来优化网络稳定性，从而提升学习性能。
AI.keywords: Lyapunov指数, 深度学习初始化, Leaky ReLU网络, 激活稳定性, 极限定理
AI.comments: 这项工作的创新之处在于将Lyapunov指数引入到深度神经网络的初始化理论中，提供了一个严格的概率框架来理解激活值的稳定性。它不仅揭示了现有初始化方法的局限性，还提出了一种理论指导的新型初始化方法，具有重要的理论和实践意义。

title: Integrating granular data into a multilayer network: an interbank model of the euro area for systemic risk assessment
summary: Micro-structural models of contagion and systemic risk emphasize that shock propagation is inherently multi-channel, spanning counterparty exposures, short-term funding and roll-over risk, securities cross-holdings, and common-asset (fire-sale) spillovers. Empirical implementations, however, often rely on stylized or simulated networks, or focus on a single exposure dimension, reflecting the practical difficulty of reconciling heterogeneous granular collections into a coherent representation with consistent identifiers and consolidation rules. We close part of this gap by constructing an empirically grounded multilayer network for euro area significant banking groups that integrates several supervisory and statistical datasets into layer-consistent exposure matrices defined on a common node set. Each layer corresponds to a distinct transmission channel, long- and short-term credit, securities cross-holdings, short-term secured funding, and overlapping external portfolios, and nodes are enriched with balance-sheet information to support model calibration. We document pronounced cross-layer heterogeneity in connectivity and centrality, and show that an aggregated (flattened) representation can mask economically relevant structure and misidentify the institutions that are systemically important in specific markets. We then illustrate how the resulting network disciplines standard systemic-risk analytics by implementing a centrality-based propagation measure and a micro-structural agent-based framework on real exposures. The approach provides a data-grounded basis for layer-aware systemic-risk assessment and stress testing across multiple dimensions of the banking network.

AI.title_translation: 将粒度数据整合到多层网络中：一个用于系统性风险评估的欧元区银行间模型
AI.tldr: 本文构建了一个基于实证的欧元区主要银行集团多层网络，整合了多种监管和统计数据集，以解决现有模型在整合异构粒度数据方面的困难，并展示了该网络如何改进系统性风险分析和压力测试。
AI.motivation: 现有的传染和系统性风险微观结构模型强调冲击传播是多渠道的，但实证实现通常依赖于风格化或模拟网络，或只关注单一暴露维度，这反映了将异构粒度数据整合为连贯表示的实际困难。
AI.method: 通过构建一个基于实证的欧元区主要银行集团多层网络来解决这一问题。该网络整合了多个监管和统计数据集，形成在共同节点集上定义的层一致暴露矩阵。每个层对应一个不同的传输渠道（长期和短期信贷、证券交叉持有、短期担保融资和重叠的外部投资组合），节点还通过资产负债表信息进行丰富，以支持模型校准。
AI.result: 记录了连接性和中心性方面显著的跨层异质性，并表明聚合（扁平化）表示可能掩盖经济上相关的结构，并错误识别在特定市场中具有系统重要性的机构。通过实施基于中心性的传播度量和基于真实暴露的微观结构代理框架，说明了所生成网络如何规范标准系统性风险分析。
AI.conclusion: 该方法为跨银行网络多个维度的分层系统性风险评估和压力测试提供了一个数据基础。
AI.translation: 传染和系统性风险的微观结构模型强调，冲击传播本质上是多渠道的，涵盖交易对手风险敞口、短期融资和展期风险、证券交叉持有以及共同资产（抛售）溢出效应。然而，实证实施通常依赖于风格化或模拟网络，或仅关注单一风险敞口维度，这反映了将异构粒度数据集整合为具有一致标识符和合并规则的连贯表示的实际困难。我们通过为欧元区主要银行集团构建一个基于经验的多层网络，弥补了这一部分空白，该网络将多个监管和统计数据集整合到在共同节点集上定义的层一致暴露矩阵中。每个层对应一个不同的传输渠道，包括长期和短期信贷、证券交叉持有、短期担保融资和重叠的外部投资组合，并且节点通过资产负债表信息进行丰富以支持模型校准。我们记录了连接性和中心性方面显著的跨层异质性，并表明聚合（扁平化）表示可能掩盖经济上相关的结构，并错误识别在特定市场中具有系统重要性的机构。然后，我们通过在真实风险敞口上实施基于中心性的传播度量和微观结构代理框架，说明了由此产生的网络如何规范标准系统性风险分析。该方法为银行网络多个维度的分层系统性风险评估和压力测试提供了一个数据基础。
AI.summary: 本文针对现有系统性风险模型在整合多渠道、异构粒度数据方面的不足，构建了一个基于实证的欧元区主要银行集团多层网络。该网络整合了多种监管和统计数据集，并区分了不同的风险传输渠道。研究发现，聚合网络表示可能掩盖重要的经济结构并错误识别系统重要性机构。该方法为银行网络多维度、分层系统性风险评估和压力测试提供了数据基础。
AI.keywords: 多层网络, 系统性风险, 银行间模型, 粒度数据, 欧元区
AI.comments: 本文的创新之处在于成功地将异构的粒度监管和统计数据整合到一个连贯的多层网络框架中，从而克服了传统系统性风险模型在数据整合方面的挑战。其重要性体现在能够更准确地识别系统性重要机构和风险传播路径，为金融监管和压力测试提供了更精细、更具实证基础的工具。通过揭示聚合网络可能掩盖的关键信息，强调了多层分析的必要性。

title: Physically Consistent Evaluation of Commonly Used Near-Field Models
comments: Submitted to the 34th edition of EUSIPCO
summary: Near-field multi-antenna wireless communication has attracted growing research interest in recent years. Despite this development, most of the current literature on antennas and reflecting structures relies on simplified models, whose validity for real systems remains unclear. In this paper, we introduce a physically consistent near-field model, which we use to evaluate commonly used models. Our results indicate that common models are sufficient for basic beamfocusing, but fail to accurately predict the sidelobes and frequency dependence of reflecting structures.
comment: Submitted to the 34th edition of EUSIPCO

AI.title_translation: 常用近场模型的物理一致性评估
AI.tldr: 常用近场模型在基本波束聚焦方面表现良好，但在旁瓣和频率依赖性预测上不准确。
AI.motivation: 当前关于天线和反射结构的大多数文献依赖于简化模型，这些模型在实际系统中的有效性尚不明确。
AI.method: 本文引入了一个物理一致的近场模型，并用它来评估常用模型。
AI.result: 研究结果表明，常用模型足以进行基本的波束聚焦，但无法准确预测反射结构的旁瓣和频率依赖性。
AI.conclusion: 常用模型在某些方面可用，但其在旁瓣和频率依赖性预测上的局限性需要考虑，更物理一致的模型对于准确预测是必要的。
AI.translation: 近年来，近场多天线无线通信引起了越来越多的研究兴趣。尽管有这样的发展，当前关于天线和反射结构的大多数文献都依赖于简化模型，这些模型在实际系统中的有效性仍然不明确。在本文中，我们引入了一个物理一致的近场模型，并用它来评估常用模型。我们的结果表明，常用模型足以进行基本的波束聚焦，但无法准确预测反射结构的旁瓣和频率依赖性。
AI.summary: 本文引入了一个物理一致的近场模型，并用它来评估常用近场模型的物理一致性。研究结果表明，常用模型足以进行基本的波束聚焦，但无法准确预测反射结构的旁瓣和频率依赖性。
AI.keywords: 近场模型, 物理一致性, 波束聚焦, 旁瓣, 频率依赖性
AI.comments: 这篇论文强调了当前简化近场模型的关键局限性，突出了在可靠系统设计中，特别是在次级辐射模式和频率响应方面，需要更准确、物理一致的模型。

title: Variational Optimality of Föllmer Processes in Generative Diffusions
summary: We construct and analyze generative diffusions that transport a point mass to a prescribed target distribution over a finite time horizon using the stochastic interpolant framework. The drift is expressed as a conditional expectation that can be estimated from independent samples without simulating stochastic processes. We show that the diffusion coefficient can be tuned \emph{a~posteriori} without changing the time-marginal distributions. Among all such tunings, we prove that minimizing the impact of estimation error on the path-space Kullback--Leibler divergence selects, in closed form, a Föllmer process -- a diffusion whose path measure minimizes relative entropy with respect to a reference process determined by the interpolation schedules alone. This yields a new variational characterization of Föllmer processes, complementing classical formulations via Schrödinger bridges and stochastic control. We further establish that, under this optimal diffusion coefficient, the path-space Kullback--Leibler divergence becomes independent of the interpolation schedule, rendering different schedules statistically equivalent in this variational sense.

AI.title_translation: 生成扩散中的 Föllmer 过程的变分最优性
AI.tldr: 该研究提出了生成扩散模型，能够将点质量在有限时间内传输到目标分布。通过对扩散系数进行后验调整，并最小化估计误差对路径空间 KL 散度的影响，最终选出了 Föllmer 过程，这为 Föllmer 过程提供了一种新的变分表征。
AI.motivation: 构建并分析了在有限时间范围内使用随机插值框架将点质量传输到指定目标分布的生成扩散模型。
AI.method: 通过随机插值框架，将点质量传输到目标分布。推导了漂移项作为条件期望的表达式，并提出了后验调整扩散系数的方法，以最小化估计误差对路径空间 KL 散度的影响，从而选择 Föllmer 过程。
AI.result: 在最优扩散系数下，路径空间 KL 散度与插值调度无关，使得不同的调度在变分意义下统计等价。
AI.conclusion: 该研究为 Föllmer 过程提供了一种新的变分表征，并证明了在最优扩散系数下，路径空间 KL 散度与插值调度无关，使得不同的调度在变分意义下统计等价。
AI.translation:
我们构建并分析了生成扩散模型，该模型在有限的时间范围内使用随机插值框架将一个点质量传输到一个指定的目标分布。漂移项可以表示为条件期望，并且可以从独立样本中估计，而无需模拟随机过程。我们证明了扩散系数可以在
'后验'的情况下进行调整，而不会改变时间边缘分布。在所有此类调整中，我们证明了最小化估计误差对路径空间 Kullback--Leibler 散度的影响，以闭合形式选择 Föllmer 过程——一种其路径测度相对于由插值调度单独确定的参考过程最小化相对熵的扩散。这产生了 Föllmer 过程的一种新的变分表征，补充了通过 Schrödinger 桥和随机控制的经典表述。我们进一步证明，在最优扩散系数下，路径空间 Kullback--Leibler 散度与插值调度无关，使得在变分意义下，不同的调度在统计上是等价的。
AI.summary: 本研究提出了一种新的生成扩散模型，该模型利用随机插值框架在有限时间内将点质量传输到目标分布。研究人员推导了漂移项的表达式，并提出了一种后验调整扩散系数的方法，以最小化估计误差对路径空间 Kullback--Leibler 散度的影响。结果表明，这种优化方法能够选择 Föllmer 过程，并为 Föllmer 过程提供了一种新的变分表征。此外，研究还发现，在最优扩散系数下，路径空间 KL 散度与插值调度无关，从而使得不同的调度在统计上等价。
AI.keywords: 生成扩散, Föllmer 过程, 随机插值, 变分最优性, Kullback--Leibler 散度
AI.comments: 这项工作在生成扩散模型和 Föllmer 过程的理论研究方面取得了重要进展。通过引入一种新的变分表征，将 Föllmer 过程与随机插值和估计误差最小化联系起来，为理解和设计更有效的生成模型提供了新的视角。然而，该研究的实际应用和计算效率仍需进一步探索。

title: Noise-balanced multilevel on-the-fly sparse grid surrogates for coupling Monte Carlo models into continuum models with application to heterogeneous catalysis
summary: Multiscale simulations utilizing high-fidelity, microscopic Monte Carlo models to provide the nonlinear response for continuum models can easily become computationally intractable. Surrogate models for the high-fidelity Monte Carlo models can overcome this but come with some challenges. One such challenges arise by the sampling noise in the underlying Monte Carlo data, which leads to uncontrolled errors possibly corrupting the surrogate even though it would be highly accurate in the case of noise-free data. Another challenge arises by the 'curse of dimensionality' when the response depends on many macro-variables. These points are addressed by a novel noise-balanced sparse grids interpolation approach which, in a quasi-optimal fashion, controls the amount of Monte Carlo sampling for each data point. The approach is complemented by a multilevel on-the-fly construction during the multiscale simulation. Besides its efficiency, a particularly appealing feature is the ease of use of the approach with only a single hyperparameter controlling the whole surrogate construction - from the surrogate's accuracy with guaranteed convergence to which data needs to be created with which accuracy. The approach is demonstrated on challenging examples from heterogeneous catalysis, coupling microscopic kinetic Monte Carlo models into macroscopic reactor simulations.

AI.title_translation: 用于将蒙特卡洛模型耦合到连续模型中的噪声平衡多层次即时稀疏网格代理模型及其在异构催化中的应用
AI.tldr: 解决蒙特卡洛噪声和高维问题，提出了一种新的、易于使用的噪声平衡多层次即时稀疏网格代理模型，用于高效耦合微观模型到连续模型。
AI.motivation: 将高保真微观蒙特卡洛模型耦合到连续模型中变得计算上难以处理，主要挑战在于底层蒙特卡洛数据的采样噪声可能破坏代理模型，以及响应依赖于许多宏观变量时出现的“维度灾难”。
AI.method: 提出了一种新颖的噪声平衡稀疏网格插值方法，该方法以准最优的方式控制每个数据点的蒙特卡洛采样量，并通过多尺度模拟期间的多层次即时构建来补充。
AI.result: 该方法能够以准最优的方式控制每个数据点的蒙特卡洛采样量，并仅通过一个超参数即可控制从代理模型的准确性（保证收敛）到需要以何种精度创建哪些数据。
AI.conclusion: 该方法在异构催化中耦合微观动力学蒙特卡洛模型到宏观反应器模拟的具有挑战性的例子中得到了验证，证明了其效率和易用性。
AI.translation: 利用高保真、微观蒙特卡洛模型为连续模型提供非线性响应的多尺度模拟很容易变得计算上难以处理。蒙特卡洛模型的高保真代理模型可以克服这些问题，但也带来一些挑战。其中一个挑战源于底层蒙特卡洛数据中的采样噪声，这会导致不可控的误差，即使在无噪声数据的情况下，代理模型可能非常准确，这些误差也可能破坏代理模型。另一个挑战源于当响应依赖于许多宏观变量时出现的“维度灾难”。本文采用了一种新颖的噪声平衡稀疏网格插值方法来解决这些问题，该方法以准最优的方式控制每个数据点的蒙特卡洛采样量。该方法通过多尺度模拟期间的多层次即时构建得到补充。除了效率之外，该方法一个特别吸引人的特点是易于使用，仅需一个超参数即可控制整个代理模型构建——从代理模型的准确性（保证收敛）到需要以何种精度创建哪些数据。该方法在异构催化中耦合微观动力学蒙特卡洛模型到宏观反应器模拟的具有挑战性的例子中得到了证明。
AI.summary: 针对将高保真蒙特卡洛模型耦合到连续模型中时面临的采样噪声和高维问题，本文提出了一种新颖的噪声平衡稀疏网格插值方法，该方法通过多层次即时构建来控制每个数据点的采样精度，仅需一个超参数即可实现高效且易于使用的代理模型构建，并在异构催化问题中得到验证。
AI.keywords: 稀疏网格, 蒙特卡洛, 噪声平衡, 多尺度模拟, 代理模型
AI.comments: 该方法创新性地结合了噪声平衡（noise-balanced）和多层次（multilevel）的“即时”（on-the-fly）稀疏网格插值，旨在解决将高保真蒙特卡洛模型耦合到连续模型时，蒙特卡洛采样噪声和高维“维度灾难”带来的误差控制和计算效率问题。其主要优势在于只需一个超参数即可控制整个过程，具有易用性。

title: Generalized Langevin Models of Linear Agent-Based Systems: Strategic Influence Through Environmental Coupling
summary: Agent-based models typically treat systems in isolation, discarding environmental coupling as either computationally prohibitive or dynamically irrelevant. We demonstrate that this neglect misses essential physics: environmental degrees of freedom create memory effects that fundamentally alter system dynamics. By systematically transforming linear update rules into exact generalized Langevin equations, we show that unobserved environmental agents manifest as memory kernels whose timescales and coupling strengths are determined by the environmental interaction spectrum. Network topology shapes this memory structure in distinct ways: small-world rewiring drives dynamics toward a single dominant relaxation mode, while fragmented environments sustain multiple persistent modes corresponding to isolated subpopulations. We apply this framework to covert influence operations where adversaries manipulate target populations exclusively via environmental intermediaries. The steady-state response admits a random-walk interpretation through hitting probabilities, revealing how zealot opinions diffuse through the environment to shift system agent opinions toward the zealot mean - even when zealots never directly contact targets.

AI.title_translation: 线性智能体系统广义 Langevin 模型：通过环境耦合进行的战略影响
AI.tldr: 忽略环境耦合会错过重要的物理学，因为环境自由度会产生改变系统动力学的记忆效应。通过将线性更新规则转化为广义 Langevin 方程，可以揭示环境代理如何通过记忆核影响系统动力学。网络拓扑会影响这种记忆结构，例如小世界重连会驱动动力学趋向单一的松弛模式，而碎片化的环境会维持多个持久模式。该框架可应用于敌方仅通过环境中间体操纵目标人群的隐蔽影响操作，揭示了狂热者观点如何通过环境传播以改变目标人群的观点，即使狂热者从未直接接触目标。
AI.motivation: 大多数智能体模型将系统视为孤立的，忽略了环境耦合，认为其计算成本高或动力学上无关紧要。然而，这种忽略会遗漏重要的物理学，即环境自由度会产生记忆效应，从根本上改变系统动力学。
AI.method: 通过系统地将线性更新规则转化为精确的广义 Langevin 方程，来模拟和分析智能体系统及其与环境的耦合。研究环境代理如何表现为记忆核，以及网络拓扑如何影响这种记忆结构。
AI.result: 环境自由度会产生记忆效应，从而从根本上改变系统动力学。网络拓扑会影响记忆结构，例如小世界重连会驱动动力学趋向单一的松弛模式，而碎片化的环境会维持多个持久模式。在隐蔽影响操作的案例中，即使狂热者不直接接触目标，他们的观点也能通过环境传播来改变目标人群的观点。
AI.conclusion: 环境耦合对于理解智能体系统的动力学至关重要，即使在计算上具有挑战性。记忆效应是由环境自由度引起的，并且可以通过广义 Langevin 方程进行量化。网络拓扑结构显著影响这些记忆效应的性质，并最终影响系统的整体行为。该框架为分析诸如隐蔽影响操作等复杂现象提供了新的视角。
AI.translation: 智能体模型通常将系统视为孤立的，将环境耦合视为计算成本高昂或动力学上无关紧要而忽略。我们证明，这种忽略会错过重要的物理学：环境自由度会产生记忆效应，从而从根本上改变系统动力学。通过系统地将线性更新规则转化为精确的广义 Langevin 方程，我们表明未被观测到的环境代理表现为记忆核，其时间尺度和耦合强度由环境相互作用谱决定。网络拓扑以不同的方式塑造这种记忆结构：小世界重连驱动动力学趋向单一的占优松弛模式，而碎片化的环境则维持对应于孤立亚群的多个持久模式。我们将此框架应用于隐蔽影响操作，其中敌方仅通过环境中间体操纵目标人群。稳态响应通过命中概率承认随机游走解释，揭示了即使狂热者从不直接接触目标，狂热者观点如何通过环境扩散以改变系统智能体的观点以趋向狂热者均值。
AI.summary: 该研究提出了一种新的框架，通过将线性智能体系统的更新规则转化为广义 Langevin 方程来分析环境耦合。研究发现，环境自由度会产生记忆效应，从而显著影响系统动力学，并且这些效应的性质取决于网络拓扑结构。该框架被应用于隐蔽影响操作的场景，揭示了即使没有直接接触，观点也能通过环境进行传播和影响。
AI.keywords: 环境耦合, 广义 Langevin 方程, 记忆效应, 网络拓扑, 隐蔽影响
AI.comments: 该研究通过引入广义 Langevin 模型来量化环境耦合对智能体系统动力学的影响，这是一个重要的理论进展。研究结果表明，忽略环境因素可能会导致对系统行为的根本性误解。尤其是在分析社会影响和信息传播等复杂系统时，这种考虑环境耦合的方法具有重要的现实意义。然而，该模型仅限于线性系统，其在非线性系统中的适用性有待进一步研究。此外，模型的参数估计和在真实世界数据中的验证也是未来研究的方向。

title: Characterizing Trainability of Instantaneous Quantum Polynomial Circuit Born Machines
summary: Instantaneous quantum polynomial quantum circuit Born machines (IQP-QCBMs) have been proposed as quantum generative models with a classically tractable training objective based on the maximum mean discrepancy (MMD) and a potential quantum advantage motivated by sampling-complexity arguments, making them an exciting model worth deeper investigation. While recent works have further proven the universality of a (slightly generalized) model, the next immediate question pertains to its trainability, i.e., whether it suffers from the exponentially vanishing loss gradients, known as the barren plateau issue, preventing effective use, and how regimes of trainability overlap with regimes of possible quantum advantage. Here, we provide significant strides in these directions. To study the trainability at initialization, we analytically derive closed-form expressions for the variances of the partial derivatives of the MMD loss function and provide general upper and lower bounds. With uniform initialization, we show that barren plateaus depend on the generator set and the spectrum of the chosen kernel. We identify regimes in which low-weight-biased kernels avoid exponential gradient suppression in structured topologies. Also, we prove that a small-variance Gaussian initialization ensures polynomial scaling for the gradient under mild conditions. As for the potential quantum advantage, we further argue, based on previous complexity-theoretic arguments, that sparse IQP families can output a probability distribution family that is classically intractable, and that this distribution remains trainable at initialization at least at lower-weight frequencies.

AI.title_translation: 即时量子多项式电路出生机器人的可训练性表征
AI.tldr: 即时量子多项式电路出生机器人（IQP-QCBMs）作为一种有潜力的量子生成模型，其训练目标基于最大均值差异（MMD），但可能面临梯度消失（barren plateau）问题。本研究分析了IQP-QCBMs在初始化的可训练性，推导了MMD损失函数导数方差的解析表达式，并给出了上下界。研究表明，在均匀初始化下， barren plateau 的情况取决于生成器集和核函数的谱；低权重偏置核在结构化拓扑中可以避免指数级梯度抑制；小方差高斯初始化在温和条件下可确保梯度多项式缩放。此外，研究还论证了稀疏 IQP 族可以输出经典上难以处理的概率分布，并且该分布在较低权重频率下是可训练的。
AI.motivation: 研究IQP-QCBMs的可训练性，特别是是否存在梯度消失问题（barren plateau），以及可训练性与潜在量子优势的重叠区域。
AI.method: 通过解析推导MMD损失函数导数方差的闭式表达式，并提供上下界来分析初始化时的可训练性。研究了不同初始化策略（均匀初始化、小方差高斯初始化）和核函数（低权重偏置核）对梯度缩放的影响。
AI.result: 在均匀初始化下， barren plateau 取决于生成器集和核函数的谱。低权重偏置核在结构化拓扑中可以避免指数级梯度抑制。小方差高斯初始化在温和条件下可确保梯度多项式缩放。稀疏 IQP 族可以输出经典上难以处理的概率分布，并且该分布在较低权重频率下是可训练的。
AI.conclusion: 本研究为理解IQP-QCBMs的可训练性提供了重要的理论基础，识别出在某些条件下可以避免 barren plateau 的策略，并连接了可训练性与潜在的量子优势。
AI.translation: 即时量子多项式量子电路出生机器人（IQP-QCBMs）已被提出作为量子生成模型，其具有基于最大均值差异（MMD）的经典可处理训练目标，以及基于采样复杂性论证的潜在量子优势，这使得它们成为一个值得深入研究的激动人心的模型。虽然最近的工作进一步证明了（稍微广义化的）模型的通用性，但下一个直接的问题是其可训练性，即它是否会遭受指数级消失的损失梯度，即所谓的 barren plateau 问题，从而阻碍有效使用，以及可训练性区域与潜在量子优势区域如何重叠。在本研究中，我们在这些方向上取得了显著进展。为了研究初始化时的可训练性，我们解析推导了MMD损失函数偏导数方差的闭式表达式，并提供了通用的上下界。在均匀初始化下，我们表明 barren plateau 取决于生成器集和所选核的谱。我们确定了低权重偏置核在结构化拓扑中可以避免指数级梯度抑制的区域。此外，我们证明了小方差高斯初始化在温和条件下可确保梯度多项式缩放。至于潜在的量子优势，我们基于先前的复杂性理论论证，进一步论证稀疏 IQP 族可以输出一个概率分布族，该分布族是经典上难以处理的，并且该分布在初始化时至少在较低权重频率下是可训练的。
AI.summary: 本研究深入探讨了即时量子多项式电路出生机器人（IQP-QCBMs）的可训练性问题。研究人员解析推导了MMD损失函数导数方差的表达式及其上下界，并分析了不同初始化策略和核函数对梯度缩放的影响，发现特定条件下（如低权重偏置核和高斯初始化）可以避免梯度消失问题。此外，研究还表明，部分IQP模型在具备量子优势的同时，在初始化时也保持了可训练性。
AI.keywords: IQP-QCBMs, 可训练性, barren plateau, MMD损失, 量子生成模型
AI.comments: 该研究在IQP-QCBMs的可训练性方面取得了重要进展，为理解和应用这类量子生成模型提供了关键的理论见解。研究结果对于设计更高效的量子机器学习算法具有重要意义。

title: A Gibbs posterior sampler for inverse problem based on prior diffusion model
summary: This paper addresses the issue of inversion in cases where (1) the observation system is modeled by a linear transformation and additive noise, (2) the problem is ill-posed and regularization is introduced in a Bayesian framework by an a prior density, and (3) the latter is modeled by a diffusion process adjusted on an available large set of examples. In this context, it is known that the issue of posterior sampling is a thorny one. This paper introduces a Gibbs algorithm. It appears that this avenue has not been explored, and we show that this approach is particularly effective and remarkably simple. In addition, it offers a guarantee of convergence in a clearly identified situation. The results are clearly confirmed by numerical simulations.

title: Renet: Principled and Efficient Relaxation for the Elastic Net via Dynamic Objective Selection
summary: We introduce Renet, a principled generalization of the Relaxed Lasso to the Elastic Net family of estimators. While, on the one hand, $\ell_1$-regularization is a standard tool for variable selection in high-dimensional regimes and, on the other hand, the $\ell_2$ penalty provides stability and solution uniqueness through strict convexity, the standard Elastic Net nevertheless suffers from shrinkage bias that frequently yields suboptimal prediction accuracy. We propose to address this limitation through a framework called \textit{relaxation}. Existing relaxation implementations rely on naive linear interpolations of penalized and unpenalized solutions, which ignore the non-linear geometry that characterizes the entire regularization path and risk violating the Karush-Kuhn-Tucker conditions. Renet addresses these limitations by enforcing sign consistency through an adaptive relaxation procedure that dynamically dispatches between convex blending and efficient sub-path refitting. Furthermore, we identify and formalize a unique synergy between relaxation and the ``One-Standard-Error'' rule: relaxation serves as a robust debiasing mechanism, allowing practitioners to leverage the parsimony of the 1-SE rule without the traditional loss in predictive fidelity. Our theoretical framework incorporates automated stability safeguards for ultra-high dimensional regimes and is supported by a comprehensive benchmarking suite across 20 synthetic and real-world datasets, demonstrating that Renet consistently outperforms the standard Elastic Net and provides a more robust alternative to the Adaptive Elastic Net in high-dimensional, low signal-to-noise ratio and high-multicollinearity regimes. By leveraging an adaptive solver backend, Renet delivers these statistical gains while offering a computational profile that remains competitive with state-of-the-art coordinate descent implementations.

title: Large Scale High-Dimensional Reduced-Rank Linear Discriminant Analysis
summary: Reduced-rank linear discriminant analysis (RRLDA) is a foundational method of dimension reduction for classification that has been useful in a wide range of applications. The goal is to identify an optimal subspace to project the observations onto that simultaneously maximizes between-group variation while minimizing within-group differences. The solution is straight forward when the number of observations is greater than the number of features but computational difficulties arise in both the high-dimensional setting, where there are more features than there are observations, and when the data are very large. Many works have proposed solutions for the high-dimensional setting and frequently involve additional assumptions or tuning parameters. We propose a fast and simple iterative algorithm for both classical and high-dimensional RRLDA on large data that is free from these additional requirements and that comes with guarantees. We also explain how RRLDA-RK provides implicit regularization towards the least norm solution without explicitly incorporating penalties. We demonstrate our algorithm on real data and highlight some results.

title: Information-Theoretic Thresholds for Bipartite Latent-Space Graphs Under Noisy Observations
summary:
We study information-theoretic phase transitions for the detectability of latent geometry in bipartite random geometric graphs RGGs with Gaussian d-dimensional latent vectors while only a subset of edges carries latent information determined by a random mask with i.i.d. Bern(q) entries. For any fixed edge density p in (0,1) we determine essentially tight thresholds for this problem as a function of d and q. Our results show that the detection problem is substantially easier if the mask is known upfront compared to the case where the mask is hidden.
  Our analysis is built upon a novel Fourier-analytic framework for bounding signed subgraph counts in Gaussian random geometric graphs that exploits cancellations which arise after approximating characteristic functions by an appropriate power series. The resulting bounds are applicable to much larger subgraphs than considered in previous work which enables tight information-theoretic bounds, while the bounds considered in previous works only lead to lower bounds from the lens of low-degree polynomials. As a consequence we identify the optimal information-theoretic thresholds and rule out computational-statistical gaps. Our bounds further improve upon the bounds on Fourier coefficients of random geometric graphs recently given by Bangachev and Bresler [STOC'24] in the dense, bipartite case. The techniques also extend to sparser and non-bipartite settings, at least if the considered subgraphs are sufficiently small. We furhter believe that they might help resolve open questions for related detection problems.

title: Reed-Muller Error-Correction Code Encoder for SFQ-to-CMOS Interface Circuits
comments: Accepted for publication in IEEE Transactions on Applied Superconductivity
summary: Data transmission from superconducting digital electronics such as single flux quantum (SFQ) logic to semiconductor (CMOS) circuits is subject to bit errors due to, e.g., flux trapping, process parameter variations (PPV), and fabrication defects. In this paper, a lightweight hardware-efficient error-correction code encoder is designed and analyzed. Particularly, a Reed-Muller code RM(1,3) encoder is implemented with SFQ digital logic. The proposed RM(1,3) encoder converts a 4-bit message into an 8-bit codeword and can detect and correct up to 3- and 1-bit errors, respectively. This encoder circuit is designed using MIT-LL SFQ5ee process and SuperTools/ColdFlux RSFQ cell library. A simulation framework integrating JoSIM simulator and MATLAB script for automated data collection and analysis, is proposed to study the performance of RM(1,3) encoder. The proposed encoder improves the probability of having no bit errors by 6.7% as compared to an encoder-less design under $\pm20\%$ PPV. With $\pm15\%$ and lower PPV, the proposed encoder could correct all errors with at least 99.1% probability. The impact of fabrication defects such as open circuit faults on the encoder circuit is also studied using the proposed framework.
comment: Accepted for publication in IEEE Transactions on Applied Superconductivity

title: Robotic Depowdering for Additive Manufacturing Via Pose Tracking
summary: With the rapid development of powder-based additive manufacturing, depowdering, a process of removing unfused powder that covers 3D-printed parts, has become a major bottleneck to further improve its productiveness. Traditional manual depowdering is extremely time-consuming and costly, and some prior automated systems either require pre-depowdering or lack adaptability to different 3D-printed parts. To solve these problems, we introduce a robotic system that automatically removes unfused powder from the surface of 3D-printed parts. The key component is a visual perception system, which consists of a pose-tracking module that tracks the 6D pose of powder-occluded parts in real-time, and a progress estimation module that estimates the depowdering completion percentage. The tracking module can be run efficiently on a laptop CPU at up to 60 FPS. Experiments show that our depowdering system can remove unfused powder from the surface of various 3D-printed parts without causing any damage. To the best of our knowledge, this is one of the first vision-based robotic depowdering systems that adapt to parts with various shapes without the need for pre-depowdering.

title: Structured Sentiment Analysis as Transition-based Dependency Graph Parsing
comments: Final peer-reviewed manuscript accepted for publication in Artificial Intelligence Review
summary: Structured sentiment analysis (SSA) aims to automatically extract people's opinions from a text in natural language and adequately represent that information in a graph structure. One of the most accurate methods for performing SSA was recently proposed and consists of approaching it as a dependency graph parsing task. Although we can find in the literature how transition-based algorithms excel in different dependency graph parsing tasks in terms of accuracy and efficiency, all proposed attempts to tackle SSA following that approach were based on graph-based models. In this article, we present the first transition-based method to address SSA as dependency graph parsing. Specifically, we design a transition system that processes the input text in a left-to-right pass, incrementally generating the graph structure containing all identified opinions. To effectively implement our final transition-based model, we resort to a Pointer Network architecture as a backbone. From an extensive evaluation, we demonstrate that our model offers the best performance to date in practically all cases among prior dependency-based methods, and surpasses recent task-specific techniques on the most challenging datasets. We additionally include an in-depth analysis and empirically prove that the average-case time complexity of our approach is quadratic in the sentence length, being more efficient than top-performing graph-based parsers.
comment: Final peer-reviewed manuscript accepted for publication in Artificial Intelligence Review

title: Multi-modal Gaussian Process Variational Autoencoders for Neural and Behavioral Data
summary: Characterizing the relationship between neural population activity and behavioral data is a central goal of neuroscience. While latent variable models (LVMs) are successful in describing high-dimensional time-series data, they are typically only designed for a single type of data, making it difficult to identify structure shared across different experimental data modalities. Here, we address this shortcoming by proposing an unsupervised LVM which extracts temporally evolving shared and independent latents for distinct, simultaneously recorded experimental modalities. We do this by combining Gaussian Process Factor Analysis (GPFA), an interpretable LVM for neural spiking data with temporally smooth latent space, with Gaussian Process Variational Autoencoders (GP-VAEs), which similarly use a GP prior to characterize correlations in a latent space, but admit rich expressivity due to a deep neural network mapping to observations. We achieve interpretability in our model by partitioning latent variability into components that are either shared between or independent to each modality. We parameterize the latents of our model in the Fourier domain, and show improved latent identification using this approach over standard GP-VAE methods. We validate our model on simulated multi-modal data consisting of Poisson spike counts and MNIST images that scale and rotate smoothly over time. We show that the multi-modal GP-VAE (MM-GPVAE) is able to not only identify the shared and independent latent structure across modalities accurately, but provides good reconstructions of both images and neural rates on held-out trials. Finally, we demonstrate our framework on two real world multi-modal experimental settings: Drosophila whole-brain calcium imaging alongside tracked limb positions, and Manduca sexta spike train measurements from ten wing muscles as the animal tracks a visual stimulus.

title: Learning-based agricultural management in partially observable environments subject to climate variability
summary: Agricultural management, with a particular focus on fertilization strategies, holds a central role in shaping crop yield, economic profitability, and environmental sustainability. While conventional guidelines offer valuable insights, their efficacy diminishes when confronted with extreme weather conditions, such as heatwaves and droughts. In this study, we introduce an innovative framework that integrates Deep Reinforcement Learning (DRL) with Recurrent Neural Networks (RNNs). Leveraging the Gym-DSSAT simulator, we train an intelligent agent to master optimal nitrogen fertilization management. Through a series of simulation experiments conducted on corn crops in Iowa, we compare Partially Observable Markov Decision Process (POMDP) models with Markov Decision Process (MDP) models. Our research underscores the advantages of utilizing sequential observations in developing more efficient nitrogen input policies. Additionally, we explore the impact of climate variability, particularly during extreme weather events, on agricultural outcomes and management. Our findings demonstrate the adaptability of fertilization policies to varying climate conditions. Notably, a fixed policy exhibits resilience in the face of minor climate fluctuations, leading to commendable corn yields, cost-effectiveness, and environmental conservation. However, our study illuminates the need for agent retraining to acquire new optimal policies under extreme weather events. This research charts a promising course toward adaptable fertilization strategies that can seamlessly align with dynamic climate scenarios, ultimately contributing to the optimization of crop management practices.

title: Provable Emergence of Deep Neural Collapse and Low-Rank Bias in $L^2$-Regularized Nonlinear Networks
summary: We present a unified theoretical framework connecting the first property of Deep Neural Collapse (DNC1) to the emergence of implicit low-rank bias in nonlinear networks trained with $L^2$ weight decay regularization. Our main contributions are threefold. First, we derive a quantitative relation between the Total Cluster Variation (TCV) of intermediate embeddings and the numerical rank of stationary weight matrices. In particular, we establish that, at any critical point, the distance from a weight matrix to the set of rank-$K$ matrices is bounded by a constant times the TCV of earlier-layer features, scaled inversely with the weight-decay parameter. Second, we prove global optimality of DNC1 in a constrained representation-cost setting for both feedforward and residual architectures, showing that zero TCV across intermediate layers minimizes the representation cost under natural architectural constraints. Third, we establish a benign landscape property: for almost every interpolating initialization there exists a continuous, loss-decreasing path from the initialization to a globally optimal, DNC1-satisfying configuration. Our theoretical claims are validated empirically; numerical experiments confirm the predicted relations among TCV, singular-value structure, and weight decay. These results indicate that neural collapse and low-rank bias are intimately linked phenomena arising from the optimization geometry induced by weight decay.

title: Goal-Conditioned Reinforcement Learning from Sub-Optimal Data on Metric Spaces
summary: We study the problem of learning optimal behavior from sub-optimal datasets for goal-conditioned offline reinforcement learning under sparse rewards, invertible actions and deterministic transitions. To mitigate the effects of \emph{distribution shift}, we propose MetricRL, a method that combines metric learning for value function approximation with weighted imitation learning for policy estimation. MetricRL avoids conservative or behavior-cloning constraints, enabling effective learning even in severely sub-optimal regimes. We introduce distance monotonicity as a key property linking metric representations to optimality and design an objective that explicitly promotes it. Empirically, MetricRL consistently outperforms prior state-of-the-art goal-conditioned RL methods in recovering near-optimal behavior from sub-optimal offline data.

title: Are Dense Labels Always Necessary for 3D Object Detection from Point Cloud?
summary: Current state-of-the-art (SOTA) 3D object detection methods often require a large amount of 3D bounding box annotations for training. However, collecting such large-scale densely-supervised datasets is notoriously costly. To reduce the cumbersome data annotation process, we propose a novel sparsely-annotated framework, in which we just annotate one 3D object per scene. Such a sparse annotation strategy could significantly reduce the heavy annotation burden, while inexact and incomplete sparse supervision may severely deteriorate the detection performance. To address this issue, we develop the SS3D++ method that alternatively improves 3D detector training and confident fully-annotated scene generation in a unified learning scheme. Using sparse annotations as seeds, we progressively generate confident fully-annotated scenes based on designing a missing-annotated instance mining module and reliable background mining module. Our proposed method produces competitive results when compared with SOTA weakly-supervised methods using the same or even more annotation costs. Besides, compared with SOTA fully-supervised methods, we achieve on-par or even better performance on the KITTI dataset with about 5x less annotation cost, and 90% of their performance on the Waymo dataset with about 15x less annotation cost. The additional unlabeled training scenes could further boost the performance.

title: SMaRTT: Sender-based Marked Rapidly-adapting Trimmed & Timed Transport
summary: With the rapid growth of artificial intelligence (AI) workloads in datacenters, the Ultra Ethernet Consortium (UEC) has defined a new high-performance transport layer to deliver the required performance at scale. A core component of this new standard is the Network Signal-based Congestion Control (NSCC) algorithm. This paper presents SMaRTT, the algorithm that forms the basis of the UEC NSCC specification. SMaRTT is a sender-based congestion control algorithm that systematically combines delay, Explicit Congestion Notification (ECN), and optional packet trimming into a cohesive state machine for fast, fair and precise window adjustments with seamless multipath support. At its core lies the novel QuickAdapt algorithm that accurately estimates and rapidly adapts to available capacity. Our evaluation shows that SMaRTT outperforms existing datacenter congestion control algorithms like Swift, RoCE, and MPRDMA by up to 50% and provides superior fairness, validating the design choices made in the UEC standard.

title: Kernel-based Optimally Weighted Conformal Time-Series Prediction
summary: In this work, we present a novel conformal prediction method for time-series, which we call Kernel-based Optimally Weighted Conformal Prediction Intervals (KOWCPI). Specifically, KOWCPI adapts the classic Reweighted Nadaraya-Watson (RNW) estimator for quantile regression on dependent data and learns optimal data-adaptive weights. Theoretically, we tackle the challenge of establishing a conditional coverage guarantee for non-exchangeable data under strong mixing conditions on the non-conformity scores. We demonstrate the superior performance of KOWCPI on real and synthetic time-series data against state-of-the-art methods, where KOWCPI achieves narrower confidence intervals without losing coverage.

title: Games with Payments between Learning Agents
summary: In repeated games, such as auctions, players rely on autonomous learning agents to choose their actions. We study settings in which players have their agents make monetary transfers to other agents during play at their own expense, in order to influence learning dynamics in their favor. Our goal is to understand when players have incentives to use such payments, how payments between agents affect learning outcomes, and what the resulting implications are for welfare and its distribution. We propose a simple game-theoretic model to capture the incentive structure of such scenarios. We find that, quite generally, abstaining from payments is not robust to strategic deviations by users of learning agents: self-interested players benefit from having their agents make payments to other learners. In a broad class of games, such endogenous payments between learning agents lead to higher welfare for all players. In first- and second-price auctions, equilibria of the induced "payment-policy game" lead to highly collusive learning outcomes, with low or vanishing revenue for the auctioneer. These results highlight a fundamental challenge for mechanism design, as well as for regulatory policies, in environments where learning agents may interact in the digital ecosystem beyond a mechanism's boundaries.

title: IGC-Net for conditional average potential outcome estimation over time
summary: Estimating potential outcomes for treatments over time based on observational data is important for personalized decision-making in medicine. However, many existing methods for this task fail to properly adjust for time-varying confounding and thus yield biased estimates. There are only a few neural methods with proper adjustments, but these have inherent limitations (e.g., division by propensity scores that are often close to zero), which result in poor performance. As a remedy, we introduce the iterative G-computation network (IGC-Net). Our IGC-Net is a novel, neural end-to-end model which adjusts for time-varying confounding in order to estimate conditional average potential outcomes (CAPOs) over time. Specifically, our IGC-Net is the first neural model to perform fully regression-based iterative G-computation for CAPOs in the time-varying setting. We evaluate the effectiveness of our IGC-Net across various experiments. In sum, this work represents a significant step towards personalized decision-making from electronic health records.

title: Towards Better Code Understanding in Decoder-Only Models with Contrastive Learning
summary: Recent advances in large-scale code generation models have led to remarkable progress in producing high-quality code. These models are trained in a self-supervised manner on extensive unlabeled code corpora using a decoder-only architecture. However, despite their generative strength, decoder-only models often exhibit limited performance on code understanding tasks such as code search and clone detection, primarily due to their generation-oriented training objectives. While training large encoder-only models from scratch on massive code datasets can improve understanding ability but remains computationally expensive and time-consuming. In this paper, we explore a more efficient alternative by transferring knowledge from pre-trained decoder-only code generation models to code understanding tasks. We investigate how decoder-only architectures can be effectively adapted to learn discriminative and semantically meaningful code representations. To this end, we propose CL4D, a contrastive learning framework tailored to strengthen the representation capabilities of decoder-only models. Extensive experiments on multiple benchmark datasets demonstrate that CL4D achieves competitive or superior performance compared to existing methods on representative code understanding tasks, including code search and clone detection. Further analysis reveals that CL4D substantially improves the semantic alignment of code representations by reducing the distance between semantically similar code snippets. These findings highlight the feasibility of leveraging decoder-only models as a unified backbone for both code generation and understanding.

title: Exponential time differencing for matrix-valued dynamical systems
summary: Matrix evolution equations occur in many applications, such as dynamical Lyapunov/Sylvester systems or Riccati equations in optimization and stochastic control, machine learning or data assimilation. In many such problems, the dominant stability restriction is imposed by a stiff linear term, making standard explicit integrators impractical. Exponential time differencing (ETD) is known to produce highly stable numerical schemes by treating the linear term in an exact fashion. In particular, for stiff problems, ETD methods are the methods of choice. We extend ETD to matrix-valued evolution equations of the form $\dot Q = LQ + QR + N(Q,t)$ by deriving explicit matrix-ETD (METD) schemes. When $L$ and $R$ commute, we construct an explicit $p$-th order METD$p$ family and prove order-$p$ global convergence under standard assumptions; for the non-commuting case, we develop a Baker-Campbell-Hausdorff (BCH)-based extension. This allows us to produce highly efficient and stable integration schemes. We demonstrate efficiency and applicability on stiff PDE-derived and large-scale matrix dynamics, including an Allen-Cahn system, turbulent jet fluctuation statistics, and continuous graph neural networks. We further show that the scheme is more accurate, stable, and efficient than competing schemes in large-scale high-rank stiff systems.

title: Implicit Probabilistic Reasoning Does Not Reflect Explicit Answers in Large Language Models
comments: Published in Transactions on Machine Learning Research
summary: The handling of probabilities in the form of uncertainty or partial information is an essential task for LLMs in many settings and applications. A common approach to evaluate an LLM's probabilistic reasoning capabilities is to assess its ability to answer questions pertaining to probability through the use of multiple-choice questions (MCQs). However, this paradigm, which we refer to as explicit probabilistic reasoning, has been shown in the literature to yield significant limitations (e.g., sensitivity to answer ordering). In this work, we introduce an alternative approach, named implicit probabilistic reasoning, which evaluates the models' ability to integrate probabilistic reasoning into their text generation process. To achieve this, we rephrase MCQs as text-completion scenarios with a determined set of outcomes and compare the model's next-token probability assignments to the true likelihood of the outcomes. In line with previous work, we find that models exhibit solid performance in their explicit probabilistic reasoning (i.e., answers to MCQs). However, during text completion (i.e., implicit probabilistic reasoning), where the same information must be taken into account to generate text, the models' predictions often significantly diverge from the known ground truth. For instance, our evaluation method reveals that implicit probabilistic reasoning is improperly influenced by many factors, such as independent prior events, partial observations about a result, or statistical background information. All of these issues can cause erroneous results to be produced in text generation, which are not detected by conventional MCQ-based evaluation.
comment: Published in Transactions on Machine Learning Research

title: Multigrid Monte Carlo Revisited: Theory and Bayesian Inference
comments: 64 pages, 4 figures, 2 tables; to appear in "Foundations of Computational Mathematics"
summary: Gaussian random fields play an important role in many areas of science and engineering. In practice, they are often simulated by sampling from a high-dimensional multivariate normal distribution, which arises from the discretisation of a suitable precision operator. Existing methods such as Cholesky factorization and Gibbs sampling become prohibitively expensive on fine meshes due to their high computational cost. In this work, we revisit the Multigrid Monte Carlo (MGMC) algorithm developed by Goodman & Sokal (Physical Review D 40.6, 1989) in the quantum physics context. While the authors of this paper conclude that MGMC does not overcome critical slowing down in simulations of field theories near phase transitions, we demonstrate here that it has the potential to significantly accelerate sampling in spatial statistics. The class of Gaussian Random Fields we consider includes those with Matérn covariance, but is more general in that it also allows for non-stationary covariance functions. To show that MGMC can overcome the limitation of existing methods, we establish a grid-size-independent convergence theory based on the link between linear solvers and samplers for multivariate normal distributions, drawing on standard multigrid convergence arguments. We then apply this theory to linear Bayesian inverse problems. This application is achieved by extending the standard multigrid theory to operators with a low-rank perturbation. Moreover, we develop a novel bespoke random smoother which takes care of the low-rank updates that arise in constructing posterior moments. In particular, we prove that Multigrid Monte Carlo is algorithmically optimal in the limit of the grid-size going to zero. Numerical results support our theory, demonstrating that Multigrid Monte Carlo can be significantly more efficient than alternative methods when applied in a Bayesian setting.
comment: 64 pages, 4 figures, 2 tables; to appear in "Foundations of Computational Mathematics"

title: Metareasoning in uncertain environments: a meta-BAMDP framework
summary: \textit{Reasoning} may be viewed as an algorithm $P$ that makes a choice of an action $a^* \in \mathcal{A}$, aiming to optimize some outcome. However, executing $P$ itself bears costs (time, energy, limited capacity, etc.) and needs to be considered alongside explicit utility obtained by making the choice in the underlying decision problem. Finding the right $P$ can itself be framed as an optimization problem over the space of reasoning processes $P$, generally referred to as \textit{metareasoning}. Conventionally, human metareasoning models assume that the agent knows the transition and reward distributions of the underlying MDP. This paper generalizes such models by proposing a meta Bayes-Adaptive MDP (meta-BAMDP) framework to handle metareasoning in environments with unknown reward/transition distributions, which encompasses a far larger and more realistic set of planning problems that humans and AI systems face. As a first step, we apply the framework to Bernoulli bandit tasks. Owing to the meta problem's complexity, our solutions are necessarily approximate. However, we introduce two novel theorems that significantly enhance the tractability of the problem, enabling stronger approximations that are robust within a range of assumptions grounded in realistic human decision-making scenarios. These results offer a resource-rational perspective and a normative framework for understanding human exploration under cognitive constraints, as well as providing experimentally testable predictions about human behavior in Bernoulli Bandit tasks.

title: Proficient Graph Neural Network Design by Accumulating Knowledge on Large Language Models
comments: Accepted at WSDM 2026. Title changed from "Computation-friendly graph neural network design by accumulating knowledge on large language models" to "Proficient Graph Neural Network Design by Accumulating Knowledge on Large Language Models"
summary: High-level automation is increasingly critical in AI, driven by rapid advances in large language models (LLMs) and AI agents. However, LLMs, despite their general reasoning power, struggle significantly in specialized, data-sensitive tasks such as designing Graph Neural Networks (GNNs). This difficulty arises from (1) the inherent knowledge gaps in modeling the intricate, varying relationships between graph properties and suitable architectures and (2) the external noise from misleading descriptive inputs, often resulting in generic or even misleading model suggestions. Achieving proficiency in designing data-aware models -- defined as the meta-level capability to systematically accumulate, interpret, and apply data-specific design knowledge -- remains challenging for existing automated approaches, due to their inefficient construction and application of meta-knowledge. To achieve meta-level proficiency, we propose DesiGNN, a knowledge-centered framework that systematically converts past model design experience into structured, fine-grained knowledge priors well-suited for meta-learning with LLMs. To account for the inherent variability and external noise, DesiGNN aligns empirical property filtering from extensive benchmarks with adaptive elicitation of literature insights via LLMs. By constructing a solid meta-knowledge between unseen graph understanding and known effective architecture patterns, DesiGNN can deliver top-5.77% initial model proposals for unseen datasets within seconds and achieve consistently superior performance with minimal search cost compared to baselines.
comment: Accepted at WSDM 2026. Title changed from "Computation-friendly graph neural network design by accumulating knowledge on large language models" to "Proficient Graph Neural Network Design by Accumulating Knowledge on Large Language Models"

title: ZebraPose: Zebra Detection and Pose Estimation using only Synthetic Data
comments: 17 pages, 5 tables, 13 figures. Published in WACV 2026
summary: Collecting and labeling large real-world wild animal datasets is impractical, costly, error-prone, and labor-intensive. For animal monitoring tasks, as detection, tracking, and pose estimation, out-of-distribution viewpoints (e.g. aerial) are also typically needed but rarely found in publicly available datasets. To solve this, existing approaches synthesize data with simplistic techniques that then necessitate strategies to bridge the synthetic-to-real gap. Therefore, real images, style constraints, complex animal models, or pre-trained networks are often leveraged. In contrast, we generate a fully synthetic dataset using a 3D photorealistic simulator and demonstrate that it can eliminate such needs for detecting and estimating 2D poses of wild zebras. Moreover, existing top-down 2D pose estimation approaches using synthetic data assume reliable detection models. However, these often fail in out-of-distribution scenarios, e.g. those that include wildlife or aerial imagery. Our method overcomes this by enabling the training of both tasks using the same synthetic dataset. Through extensive benchmarks, we show that models trained from scratch exclusively on our synthetic data generalize well to real images. We perform these using multiple real-world and synthetic datasets, pre-trained and randomly initialized backbones, and different image resolutions. Code, results, models, and data can be found athttps://zebrapose.is.tue.mpg.de/.
comment: 17 pages, 5 tables, 13 figures. Published in WACV 2026

title: Measuring Orthogonality as the Blind-Spot of Uncertainty Disentanglement
summary: Aleatoric (data) and epistemic (knowledge) uncertainty are textbook components of Uncertainty Quantification. Jointly estimating these components has been shown to be problematic and non-trivial. As a result, there are multiple ways to disentangle these uncertainties, but current methods to evaluate them are insufficient. We propose that aleatoric and epistemic uncertainty estimates should be orthogonally disentangled - meaning that each uncertainty is not affected by the other - a necessary condition that is often not met. We prove that orthogonality and consistency and necessary and sufficient criteria for disentanglement, and construct Uncertainty Disentanglement Error as a metric to measure these criteria, with further empirical evaluation showing that finetuned models give different orthogonality results than models trained from scratch and that UDE can be optimized for through dropout rate. We demonstrate a Deep Ensemble trained from scratch on ImageNet-1k with Information Theoretic disentangling achieves consistent and orthogonal estimates of epistemic uncertainty, but estimates of aleatoric uncertainty still fail on orthogonality.

title: Prioritizing Risk Factors in Media Entrepreneurship on Social Networks: Hybrid Fuzzy Z-Number Approaches for Strategic Budget Allocation and Risk Management in Advertising Construction Campaigns
summary: The proliferation of complex online media has accelerated the process of ideology formation, influenced by stakeholders through advertising channels. The media channels, which vary in cost and effectiveness, present a dilemma in prioritizing optimal fund allocation. There are technical challenges in describing the optimal budget allocation between channels over time, which involves defining the finite vector structure of controls on the chart. To enhance marketing productivity, it's crucial to determine how to distribute a budget across all channels to maximize business outcomes like revenue and ROI. Therefore, the strategy for media budget allocation is primarily an exercise focused on cost and achieving goals, by identifying a specific framework for a media program. Numerous researchers optimize the achievement and frequency of media selection models to aid superior planning decisions amid complexity and vast information availability. In this study, we present a planning model using the media mix model for advertising construction campaigns. Additionally, a decision-making strategy centered on FMEA identifies and prioritizes financial risk factors of the media system in companies. Despite some limitations, this research proposes a decision-making approach based on Z-number theory. To address the drawbacks of the RPN score, the suggested decision-making methodology integrates Z-SWARA and Z-WASPAS techniques with the FMEA method.

title: Enhancing Inverse Reinforcement Learning through Encoding Dynamic Information in Reward Shaping
summary: In this paper, we aim to tackle the limitation of the Adversarial Inverse Reinforcement Learning (AIRL) method in stochastic environments where theoretical results cannot hold and performance is degraded. To address this issue, we propose a novel method which infuses the dynamics information into the reward shaping with the theoretical guarantee for the induced optimal policy in the stochastic environments. Incorporating our novel model-enhanced rewards, we present a novel Model-Enhanced AIRL framework, which integrates transition model estimation directly into reward shaping. Furthermore, we provide a comprehensive theoretical analysis of the reward error bound and performance difference bound for our method. The experimental results in MuJoCo benchmarks show that our method can achieve superior performance in stochastic environments and competitive performance in deterministic environments, with significant improvement in sample efficiency, compared to existing baselines.

title: Towards Privacy-Guaranteed Label Unlearning in Vertical Federated Learning: Few-Shot Forgetting without Disclosure
comments: We introduce the first method for label unlearning in vertical federated learning (VFL), focused on preventing label leakage by the active party
summary: This paper addresses the critical challenge of unlearning in Vertical Federated Learning (VFL), a setting that has received far less attention than its horizontal counterpart. Specifically, we propose the first method tailored to \textit{label unlearning} in VFL, where labels play a dual role as both essential inputs and sensitive information. To this end, we employ a representation-level manifold mixup mechanism to generate synthetic embeddings for both unlearned and retained samples. This is to provide richer signals for the subsequent gradient-based label forgetting and recovery steps. These augmented embeddings are then subjected to gradient-based label forgetting, effectively removing the associated label information from the model. To recover performance on the retained data, we introduce a recovery-phase optimization step that refines the remaining embeddings. This design achieves effective label unlearning while maintaining computational efficiency. We validate our method through extensive experiments on diverse datasets, including MNIST, CIFAR-10, CIFAR-100, ModelNet, Brain Tumor MRI, COVID-19 Radiography, and Yahoo Answers demonstrate strong efficacy and scalability. Overall, this work establishes a new direction for unlearning in VFL, showing that re-imagining mixup as an efficient mechanism can unlock practical and utility-preserving unlearning. The code is publicly available at \href{https://github.com/bryanhx/Towards-Privacy-Guaranteed-Label-Unlearning-in-Vertical-Federated-Learning}{https://github.com/bryanhx/Towards-Privacy-Guaranteed-Label-Unlearning-in-Vertical-Federated-Learning}
